migration: No schema or pose changes. Select the existing dataset root explicitly. Valid V23 data remain readable. Old collection-v1 bundles need selected-scene rebuild as before. Missing/corrupt promised prediction evidence now blocks export.
limitations: Empty board photo replay validates registration and storage; no physical D39 vehicle accuracy or all-view geometry claim.
Photo OCR reuses 35 real V23 CPU observations of identical pixels/arguments; fresh OCR calls this task: zero.
Registration requires visible names and sufficient painted-line evidence; glare, occlusion and low resolution may cause abstention.
Three painted sides and a virtual entrance are separate; the existing computational polygon remains closed and unchanged.
No trained occupancy or vehicle-mask model bundled. Missing sticker without model/reference remains unknown, not vacant.
Zone-type comparison and background-change warnings do not establish vehicle-outline parking violations.
No visible UI click/DPI inspection this task; withdrawn Tk automation covers tested transitions.
No physical camera/GPU/trained occupancy model/live server/Geti/long-run tests.
Write fault tests use SystemExit after durable writes, not physical power loss or OneDrive concurrency.
One writer per dataset; no multiprocess lock or automatic bulk migration/deduplication.
Automatic candidates differ from human-approved ground truth; file completeness does not establish recognition accuracy.
Export copies and preserves originals; export receipt JSON is separate from data JSON count.
